title: Adverbs of Frequency
intro: always (100%), usually, often, sometimes, never (0%). Letakkan adverb sebelum kata kerja utama (I always eat), tetapi setelah am, is, dan are (He is always late).

exercises.prompt: Match each adverb to how often it means
exercises.explanation: always = 100%, usually = sekitar 85%, often = sekitar 60%, sometimes = sekitar 30%, never = 0%.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Adverb of frequency diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama: I always eat.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Adverb diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama: She never drinks. Ingat, 'she' memakai bentuk -s.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.explanation: Dengan kata kerja 'to be' (am, is, are), adverb diletakkan setelahnya: He is always late.

exercises.question: They ___ tired on Monday.
exercises.explanation: Setelah am, is, atau are, adverb diletakkan setelah kata kerja: They are usually tired.

exercises.question: I ___ eat vegetables. I really don't like them.
exercises.explanation: 'I really don't like them' berarti 0% dari waktu, jadi adverb yang tepat adalah never.

exercises.question: Pick the sentence with the adverb in the right place.
options: She usually goes to bed at 10.
She goes usually to bed at 10.
She goes to bed usually at 10.
exercises.answer: She usually goes to bed at 10.
exercises.explanation: Adverb diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama: She usually goes.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence using the words in brackets
exercises.explanation: Adverb diletakkan sebelum kata kerja utama: often play. Dengan 'we', kata kerja tetap dalam bentuk dasar.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about your weekend using an adverb of frequency.
exercises.modelAnswer: I usually sleep late on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan present simple dan letakkan adverb sebelum kata kerja utama, misalnya 'I usually sleep late on Sunday.'
